topic: Sciatica: leg pain from your back
caption:
Zapping pain from your buttock down your leg? ⚡
An irritated lower back nerve can refer pain down the leg. Gentle movement within comfort usually helps recovery.

⚠️ Bladder/bowel changes, saddle numbness or weakness in both legs need emergency care immediately.
